text_block_list.text:
The last day of summer camp.
While doing my daily check of my emails—
An email arrived with the subject line: "Notice of Official URA Merchandise Decision".

Aston Machan grabbed the laptop I was showing her
and stared intently at the screen up close.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Following your stellar performance in the Oka Sho, Sprinters Stakes, and numerous other races,
we would love to discuss turning you into merchandise—"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"...In particular,
we understand you requested a mascot..."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The most surprising things
always come out of nowhere, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The bus is about to leave,
so no matter how you look at it,
this is no time to be sitting around.
I couldn't just let her run all the way home. But even if I chased after her in a panic, there was no way I'd catch up anytime soon—

I finally managed to catch her
as she was bouncing around on the high platform.
